entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the dimly lit basement of the pa..."
entries.dialogueText: In the dimly lit basement of the palace, I found myself flanked by Titus and Sevrio.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Revolutionaries, armed to the teeth..."
entries.dialogueText: Revolutionaries, armed to the teeth with a menacing array of weaponry, were pushing against the palace gates.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "While no shots had been fired, tens..."
entries.dialogueText: While no shots had been fired, tension hung heavy in the air, as if the slightest spark would ignite the powder keg of unrest.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's too many of them. We don't..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's too many of them. We don't stand a chance. I'll address them from the palace balcony -- try to calm them down or at least buy us some time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We can't rely on outside help. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't rely on outside help. We have to get to the helipad on our own. It's risky, but it's our only means of escape."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We'll barricade ourselves here and..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll barricade ourselves here and hold out until help arrives. We have no choice but to wait."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe I'm saying this, but I'm scared. There are just too many of them."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""They've trampled straight through..."
entries.dialogueText: "They've trampled straight through the hedge maze. That'll take weeks to replant."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll do whatever it takes to prote..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll do whatever it takes to protect you. Both of you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm afraid you're right.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid you're right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry. Everything's going to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. Everything's going to be fine."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Collective gasps and shouts of disb..."
entries.dialogueText: Collective gasps and shouts of disbelief suddenly erupted from all around me. I turned back to the security monitor.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If it weren't for {RiziaDLCText.Ki..."
entries.dialogueText: "If it weren't for {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon}, I'd insist we hold the capital at all costs. But Romus... I think this is it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He'd stayed by my side even as the..."
entries.dialogueText: He'd stayed by my side even as the revolutionaries closed in on Porte Drazon, drinking glass after glass of wine with me and listening to me reminisce about the days when kings still held power.

entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'll try my best to keep up. But d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll try my best to keep up. But don't slow down because of me."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I'm with you, Rom. Always.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm with you, Rom. Always."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My guards awaited my instructions."
entries.dialogueText: My guards awaited my instructions.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned to see my guards, their ex..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned to see my guards, their expectant gazes awaiting my command.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""They'd better arrive soon, or we'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "They'd better arrive soon, or we're finished."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Let's hope they arrive soon or we'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's hope they arrive soon or we're done for."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My guards turned to me for instruct..."
entries.dialogueText: My guards turned to me for instructions.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Stay with us. Grab whatever you ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stay with us. Grab whatever you can and barricade the door."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We need reinforcements. Go round u..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need reinforcements. Go round up as many other guards as you can."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All of you, come with me. We need..."
entries.dialogueText: "All of you, come with me. We need every available hand to make it through."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""One of you remain here in case the..."
entries.dialogueText: "One of you remain here in case there's any attempt to contact us over the radio."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come with me. I can't go out there..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come with me. I can't go out there without any guards."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Stay here and defend this room wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stay here and defend this room with your lives. Is that clear?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a salute, two of my guards rus..."
entries.dialogueText: With a salute, two of my guards rushed out of the room as quickly as they could. In the meantime, we needed to block the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They saluted and fell in step behin..."
entries.dialogueText: They saluted and fell in step behind me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They gave a resounding "Yes, sir!"..."
entries.dialogueText: They gave a resounding "Yes, sir!" and saluted me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They saluted and fell into step beh..."
entries.dialogueText: They saluted and fell into step behind me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One of the guards saluted before at..."
entries.dialogueText: One of the guards saluted before attempting to tune into a radio channel.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They saluted me and scanned the roo..."
entries.dialogueText: They saluted me and scanned the room for anything they could use to block the door.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If I don't make it back, know that..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I don't make it back, know that I will always love you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Remember me well.""
entries.dialogueText: "Remember me well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I kissed him. He had tears in his e..."
entries.dialogueText: I kissed him. He had tears in his eyes as I pulled away.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I kissed her. She had tears in her..."
entries.dialogueText: I kissed her. She had tears in her eyes as I pulled away.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I left the room."
entries.dialogueText: I left the room.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "We slipped out of the room as quiet..."
entries.dialogueText: We slipped out of the room as quietly as possible and ascended nearby stairs to the ground floor.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And then we waited."
entries.dialogueText: And then we waited.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I moved the table to block the door..."
entries.dialogueText: I moved the table to block the door.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I moved the bookshelf to block the..."
entries.dialogueText: I moved the bookshelf to block the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard the sound of footsteps appr..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard the sound of footsteps approaching from the level above, gradually drawing closer and closer.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who is this?""
entries.dialogueText: "Who is this?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Identify yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: "Identify yourself."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before long, there was a knock on t..."
entries.dialogueText: Before long, there was a knock on the door. I gripped my gun firmly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I did not answer."
entries.dialogueText: I did not answer.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I opened the door."
entries.dialogueText: I opened the door.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I did not open the door."
entries.dialogueText: I did not open the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard the muffled voices of multi..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard the muffled voices of multiple people in the hallway. I couldn't make out who it was.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a short while, the people on..."
entries.dialogueText: After a short while, the people on the other side left.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was the returning sentries bring..."
entries.dialogueText: It was the returning sentries bringing along four other Golden Guards.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Before we proceed, we need additio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before we proceed, we need additional reinforcements. Hurry and seek out more guards to aid in our defense."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They saluted me and dashed out of t..."
entries.dialogueText: They saluted me and dashed out of the room as fast as possible.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We waited, anxious for the return o..."
entries.dialogueText: We waited, anxious for the return of our reinforcements. Knowing that armed militants were rampaging through the palace made the minutes feel like hours.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was the returning sentries bring..."
entries.dialogueText: It was the returning sentries bringing along two other Golden Guards.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was Sevrio, bringing along seven..."
entries.dialogueText: It was Sevrio, bringing along seven other Wruhec's Guardians.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My guards returned. They couldn't f..."
entries.dialogueText: My guards returned. They couldn't find anyone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They entered and informed us that t..."
entries.dialogueText: They entered and informed us that the revolutionaries were closing in, urging us to prepare for the imminent threat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was one of the palace cleaners,..."
entries.dialogueText: It was one of the palace cleaners, trying to run away from the militants.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was then I heard an increasing n..."
entries.dialogueText: It was then I heard an increasing number of footsteps growing louder by the second.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They were rapidly approaching."
entries.dialogueText: They were rapidly approaching.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We continued reinforcing the door...."
entries.dialogueText: We continued reinforcing the door. Before long, the footsteps stopped right outside our barricade.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I listened closely to understand wh..."
entries.dialogueText: I listened closely to understand what was going on.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I remained still, waiting to see wh..."
entries.dialogueText: I remained still, waiting to see what would happen.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "That's when I heard a loud piercing..."
entries.dialogueText: That's when I heard a loud piercing beep.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""GET DOWN!""
entries.dialogueText: "GET DOWN!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""IT'S THEM!""
entries.dialogueText: "IT'S THEM!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""RUN!""
entries.dialogueText: "RUN!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "That's when I heard a loud beep."
entries.dialogueText: That's when I heard a loud beep.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The door burst open with a deafenin..."
entries.dialogueText: The door burst open with a deafening explosion, knocking me to the ground as an intense sound and flash overwhelmed me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a deafening explosion, the doo..."
entries.dialogueText: With a deafening explosion, the door burst open, knocking me to the ground as an intense sound and flash overwhelmed me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A barrage of gunfire suddenly erupt..."
entries.dialogueText: A barrage of gunfire suddenly erupted from the hall -- the smoke from the explosion obscuring the gunmen -- and I took off running.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I took cover behind the table."
entries.dialogueText: I took cover behind the table.

entries.dialogueText: As did Pabel.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An eerie silence settled in, and a..."
entries.dialogueText: An eerie silence settled in, and a slow, creeping terror began to consume my thoughts.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could feel the sharp glass and sp..."
entries.dialogueText: I could feel the sharp glass and splinters piercing my skin as I crawled on the ground.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before I knew it, a mob of masked m..."
entries.dialogueText: Before I knew it, a mob of masked militants wielding automatic rifles stormed the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All of my guards were dead."
entries.dialogueText: All of my guards were dead.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They aimed their rifles in my direc..."
entries.dialogueText: They aimed their rifles in my direction the moment I was identified.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Glancing over at Lucita, I was reli..."
entries.dialogueText: Glancing over at Lucita, I was relieved to see her unharmed. At least for the moment.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My remaining guards threw down thei..."
entries.dialogueText: My remaining guards threw down their weapons.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "That's when I realized that I was t..."
entries.dialogueText: That's when I realized that I was the only one still holding a gun. The militants were yelling at me to lower it.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I dropped my weapon."
entries.dialogueText: I dropped my weapon.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I raised the barrel."
entries.dialogueText: I raised the barrel.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All I heard was a click. The magazi..."
entries.dialogueText: All I heard was a click. The magazine was empty.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I targeted the man in the lead, sho..."
entries.dialogueText: I targeted the man in the lead, shooting him in the head. In response, all rifles redirected their aim towards me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please. I beg you. Don't hurt me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please. I beg you. Don't hurt me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“I’ll give you anything you want. N..."
entries.dialogueText: “I’ll give you anything you want. Name your price. Just let us go.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They closed in on me, delivering a..."
entries.dialogueText: They closed in on me, delivering a blow to my gut before binding my wrists with handcuffs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One of them stepped forward and kic..."
entries.dialogueText: One of them stepped forward and kicked the gun away with his boot.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will pay for what you've done.""
entries.dialogueText: "You will pay for what you've done."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I loaded a magazine into my gun and..."
entries.dialogueText: I loaded a magazine into my gun and pulled back the slide, preparing for the worst.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was Sevrio, accompanied by six a..."
entries.dialogueText: It was Sevrio, accompanied by six additional Wruhec's Guardians.

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""They're closing in, Your Majesty...."
entries.dialogueText: "They're closing in, Your Majesty. We've got to act fast."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One of the guards carefully opened..."
entries.dialogueText: One of the guards carefully opened the door and peeked around the corner. Seeing the coast was clear, he motioned for us to follow.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "We hurried toward the garden exit."
entries.dialogueText: We hurried toward the garden exit.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Instead of charging toward the exit..."
entries.dialogueText: Instead of charging toward the exit at full speed, we took a cautious approach.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our small group advanced a few mete..."
entries.dialogueText: Our small group advanced a few meters at a time, using columns and other obstructions as cover.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I couldn't believe that I was fleei..."
entries.dialogueText: I couldn't believe that I was fleeing my own palace.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was the most direct route but wo..."
entries.dialogueText: It was the most direct route but would leave us exposed.

entries.title: Narrator: "Palas Rezna, my home, was on fire."
entries.dialogueText: Palas Rezna, my home, was on fire.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ahead of me, a set of doors led to..."
entries.dialogueText: Ahead of me, a set of doors led to a long stairwell.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Five flights later, I emerged into..."
entries.dialogueText: Five flights later, I emerged into the upper-level corridor, still untouched by the armed assailants. The balcony was in the audience chamber at the far end of the hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And that's when it hit me."
entries.dialogueText: And that's when it hit me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand you now, Father. Perh..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand you now, Father. Perhaps I've grasped the depths of disgrace and shame a little too late."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Like father like son... 'Frail.' A..."
entries.dialogueText: "Like father like son... 'Frail.' Am I destined to bear the same name?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You should have never been the Kin..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should have never been the King."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I should have never been the King.""
entries.dialogueText: "I should have never been the King."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Unsurprisingly, his portrait didn't..."
entries.dialogueText: Unsurprisingly, his portrait didn't reply in return.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The distant sounds of unrest from o..."
entries.dialogueText: The distant sounds of unrest from outside snapped me back to the present.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It wasn't long before I reached the..."
entries.dialogueText: It wasn't long before I reached the doors to the audience chamber.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a deep breath."
entries.dialogueText: I took a deep breath.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Halaita.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If I die, so be it.""
entries.dialogueText: "If I die, so be it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come on, Romus. You can do this.""
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, Romus. You can do this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I opened the balcony doors."
entries.dialogueText: I opened the balcony doors.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I gazed out into the Palace grounds..."
entries.dialogueText: I gazed out into the Palace grounds. Just like during my coronation, they were packed with huge crowds of people -- except now, instead of praising my name, they were calling for my downfall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Yells and screams erupted from the..."
entries.dialogueText: Yells and screams erupted from the crowd. I had certainly captured their attention.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Porte Drazon. Hear me!""
entries.dialogueText: "Porte Drazon. Hear me!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My fellow Rizians!""
entries.dialogueText: "My fellow Rizians!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My dearest subjects!""
entries.dialogueText: "My dearest subjects!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few mocking laughs reached my ear..."
entries.dialogueText: A few mocking laughs reached my ears. Despite this, I pressed on.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand your anger, but it's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand your anger, but it's misplaced."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Everything I've done has been for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everything I've done has been for the betterment of this nation! Nothing else."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A king without his people is no ki..."
entries.dialogueText: "A king without his people is no king."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The responsibility for the mess we..."
entries.dialogueText: "The responsibility for the mess we find ourselves in rests with the other royal houses."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thought I was right, but acknowl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought I was right, but acknowledge that mistakes may have been made."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is a shame that the Rizian peop..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a shame that the Rizian people have suffered. But I am not to blame."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I love my country more than anythi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I love my country more than anything! I know you do as well. That's why you are here!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I've made my fair share of po..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I've made my fair share of poor decisions. However, let's not overlook the good ones as well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Every decision I've made has been..."
entries.dialogueText: "Every decision I've made has been with one goal in mind -- you!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am but a fellow patriot much lik..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am but a fellow patriot much like yourselves!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I beg you. Make the right choice a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I beg you. Make the right choice and release me. There's so much we can accomplish together, side by side."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I may wear the crown, but we share..."
entries.dialogueText: "I may wear the crown, but we share the same Rizian blood -- which means we are the same! I trust you to make the right call."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Break this cycle of violence and l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Break this cycle of violence and let us usher in a new era of prosperity for Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The fault lies with the system tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fault lies with the system that created this situation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even the most well-intentioned ind..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even the most well-intentioned individuals can end up in the most precarious situations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Malenyevist conspirators have cont..."
entries.dialogueText: "Malenyevist conspirators have contrived this scenario to weaken us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rot has taken place in our governm..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rot has taken place in our governmental institutions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've done all I could to stop this..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've done all I could to stop this from happening."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I need your help to bring us to a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need your help to bring us to a better future. Together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nevertheless, as your rightful kin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nevertheless, as your rightful king, I promise that better days will come."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The future of this country is in y..."
entries.dialogueText: "The future of this country is in your hands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This Kingdom owes everything to yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "This Kingdom owes everything to you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I recognize your resolve, and I co..."
entries.dialogueText: "I recognize your resolve, and I commend it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You, the people, have spoken. And..."
entries.dialogueText: "You, the people, have spoken. And I am listening."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I live only to serve this nation a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I live only to serve this nation and I will abide by the rules that make it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yet, violence can never be the ans..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet, violence can never be the answer to our issues. It will only increase our woes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you wish to claim the palace, t..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you wish to claim the palace, then come forth. It's yours."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Through unity, we will demonstrate..."
entries.dialogueText: "Through unity, we will demonstrate to the world that our resilience and strength will never be broken."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I believe in this nation and I bel..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe in this nation and I believe in you to do the right thing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What kind of a country we would be..."
entries.dialogueText: "What kind of a country we would be if we could not accept change?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But the crowd wasn't listening. The..."
entries.dialogueText: But the crowd wasn't listening. They simply chanted "Abdicate, Abdicate."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. I respect your wishes a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. I respect your wishes and hereby announce my abdication from the throne."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Despite your calls, I refuse to ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite your calls, I refuse to abdicate. For I am the only one who truly grasps your needs."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I uttered my defiance, I watched..."
entries.dialogueText: As I uttered my defiance, I watched as rifles trained on me from within the crowd. The air filled with the ominous chant of "Death to the King!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I ducked and took cover."
entries.dialogueText: I ducked and took cover.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Taking my life would mean losing t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Taking my life would mean losing the only king who's willing to listen and speak to the common man, despite his noble status."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My words fell on deaf ears. I under..."
entries.dialogueText: My words fell on deaf ears. I understood then and there what was about to happen.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At that moment, my guards ran out o..."
entries.dialogueText: At that moment, my guards ran out onto the balcony, attempting to rush me away, but they were too late.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Glancing down, I couldn't believe t..."
entries.dialogueText: Glancing down, I couldn't believe the sight of so much blood pooling beneath me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd fell silent. Each second..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd fell silent. Each second felt heavier than the last.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A single clap resonated through the..."
entries.dialogueText: A single clap resonated through the silence,  igniting a chain reaction of applause throughout the crowd.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please, heed my words... I will ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, heed my words... I will abdicate. All I ask is that you spare both me and my family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If it's riches you desire, they're..."
entries.dialogueText: "If it's riches you desire, they're yours for the taking -- all the gold you could ever want. But, please, spare the Royal Family from harm."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gunshots rang out, and the next thi..."
entries.dialogueText: Gunshots rang out, and the next thing I knew, I was lying on the ground.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have emerged victorious. Now i..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have emerged victorious. Now it is up to you to make sure it's not in vain."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now, let's stop this violence, and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, let's stop this violence, and, together, bring peace to Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let it be known that I have done a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let it be known that I have done all I could for this kingdom."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "More cheers came from the crowd. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: More cheers came from the crowd. They were chanting "Rizia! Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And then they started fading away."
entries.dialogueText: And then they started fading away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They had gotten what they came for."
entries.dialogueText: They had gotten what they came for.

entries.dialogueText: "No! Romus! Let him go!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My consciousness slowly faded."
entries.dialogueText: My consciousness slowly faded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Together with a handful of military..."
entries.dialogueText: Together with a handful of military personnel, we watched live images of the unfolding chaos on the security monitors before us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Behind them surged a relentless tid..."
entries.dialogueText: Behind them surged a relentless tide of protestors. Some were calling out for justice; others were demanding my head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She put a protective hand over her..."
entries.dialogueText: She put a protective hand over her belly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There, in stark black and white, I..."
entries.dialogueText: There, in stark black and white, I witnessed the revolutionaries breach the palace gates.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They were inside."
entries.dialogueText: They were inside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The moment I stepped out, the guard..."
entries.dialogueText: The moment I stepped out, the guards began barricading the room from the inside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before I knew it, I found myself st..."
entries.dialogueText: Before I knew it, I found myself standing beneath the portrait of my father, Valero the Frail, as if drawn to him involuntarily.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I hurried to the nearest window and..."
entries.dialogueText: I hurried to the nearest window and glanced outside. From there, I could see the crowd steadily expanding.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before long, we heard the sound of..."
entries.dialogueText: Before long, we heard the sound of approaching footsteps.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we passed another hall, a large..."
entries.dialogueText: As we passed another hall, a large mob on the far end caught my eye. Their cries of alarm resonated through the corridor.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Shots were fired. We had been seen."
entries.dialogueText: Shots were fired. We had been seen.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At one point, a restless mob surged..."
entries.dialogueText: At one point, a restless mob surged past from a hallway, but we remained motionless and evaded detection.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Once they'd moved on, we resumed ou..."
entries.dialogueText: Once they'd moved on, we resumed our slow progress. However, the murmur of voices from around a nearby corner brought us to an abrupt halt.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I strained to identify the sourc..."
entries.dialogueText: As I strained to identify the source of the sound, the polished surface of a nearby decorative vase caught my eye. Its gleaming reflection gave me the answer I was looking for.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "However, considering the number of..."
entries.dialogueText: However, considering the number of guards with us, I knew it would be a challenge to sneak past them undetected.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before long, we reached the doors l..."
entries.dialogueText: Before long, we reached the doors leading to the garden.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards that were left were more..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards that were left were more than enough to make it the rest of the way.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Only two guards remained, which was..."
entries.dialogueText: Only two guards remained, which wasn't very reassuring.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Only one guard remained, which grea..."
entries.dialogueText: Only one guard remained, which greatly reduced our chances of success.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There were no guards left. The situ..."
entries.dialogueText: There were no guards left. The situation was bleak.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As God is my witness, you will pay..."
entries.dialogueText: "As God is my witness, you will pay for what you've done."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We had to take action now."
entries.dialogueText: We had to take action now.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I froze."
entries.dialogueText: I froze.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the dimly lit basement of the pa..."
entries.dialogueText: In the dimly lit basement of the palace, I found myself flanked by Sevrio Castellanus and his loyal second-in-command.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I pray to God that all three of us..."
entries.dialogueText: "I pray to God that all three of us will make it out of here alive."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We'll rebuild everything. Together.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll rebuild everything. Together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pabel. I promise I'll do whatever..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pabel. I promise I'll do whatever it takes to protect you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No need for a stiff upper lip. I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need for a stiff upper lip. I'm scared too."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I pray to God that we'll make it o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I pray to God that we'll make it out of here alive."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beside us, Bruno let out a nervous..."
entries.dialogueText: Beside us, Bruno let out a nervous whimper. Pabel patted his head reassuringly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beside us, Bruno let out a nervous..."
entries.dialogueText: Beside us, Bruno let out a nervous whimper. Lucita patted his head reassuringly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beside me, Bruno let out a nervous..."
entries.dialogueText: Beside me, Bruno let out a nervous whimper.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry, boy. I'll do whatever..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry, boy. I'll do whatever it takes to keep you safe."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You'll protect me, won't you, Bru?""
entries.dialogueText: "You'll protect me, won't you, Bru?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I patted his head reassuringly."
entries.dialogueText: I patted his head reassuringly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus gave a nod of confirmation."
entries.dialogueText: Titus gave a nod of confirmation.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your instructions, sir?""
entries.dialogueText: "Your instructions, sir?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I need one of the guards to stay b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need one of the guards to stay behind in case there's an attempt to contact us over the radio."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Good thinking. I'll stick with you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good thinking. I'll stick with you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Before we proceed, we need additio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before we proceed, we need additional reinforcements. Hurry and seek out more guards to assist in our defense."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Right away.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right away."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus saluted me and dashed out of..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus saluted me and dashed out of the room as fast as possible.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus appeared in the doorway."
entries.dialogueText: Titus appeared in the doorway.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I've brought four additional Golde..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've brought four additional Golden Guardsmen. You should be well protected."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I've brought two additional Golden..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've brought two additional Golden Guardsmen. We'll cover you as best we can."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We have to move fast, though. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have to move fast, though. The enemy is closing in."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus, stay with me. Everyone else..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus, stay with me. Everyone else, go create a distraction."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus, can one of your guards crea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus, can one of your guards create a distraction?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus, I need you to create a dist..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus, I need you to create a distraction."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'll do what I can.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll do what I can."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My bodyguard swallowed."
entries.dialogueText: My bodyguard swallowed.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty... In case I don't ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... In case I don't make it, it's been an honor serving you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Stop talking nonsense! Of course,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stop talking nonsense! Of course, you'll make it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The honor has been all mine.""
entries.dialogueText: "The honor has been all mine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I told you to create a distraction..."
entries.dialogueText: "I told you to create a distraction. What the hell are you waiting for?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Glovurius axa Rizia.""
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Yes, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""You heard His Majesty. Move.""
entries.dialogueText: "You heard His Majesty. Move."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus motioned to his remaining gua..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus motioned to his remaining guardsmen. They stepped out to face the mob.

entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, your strength surpasses that of any title."

entries.dialogueText: "You possess the strength and wisdom to lead us forward with honor."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Sire, your reign has been marked by resilience and courage."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "'Frail' is but a word, not a reflection of your indomitable spirit."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please focus on the task at hand,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please focus on the task at hand, Titus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is neither the time nor the p..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is neither the time nor the place for flattery!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for supporting your king..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for supporting your king in his darkest hour."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May God grant me the strength to l..."
entries.dialogueText: "May God grant me the strength to live up to your belief in me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A loud commotion drew everyone's at..."
entries.dialogueText: A loud commotion drew everyone's attention to the unrest outside the palace.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We should get moving, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "We should get moving, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I gave a curt nod, signaling Titus..."
entries.dialogueText: I gave a curt nod, signaling Titus to proceed.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, there's nothing to be ashamed of."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "You are the rightful king, and we stand with you."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Divus zaitu!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Shut up and listen to me!"

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Titus gave a nod of confirmation.

entries.dialogueText: In the dimly lit basement of the palace, I found myself flanked by Titus and his second-in-command in the Golden Guard.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the dimly lit basement of the pa..."
entries.dialogueText: In the dimly lit basement of the palace, I found myself flanked by the new captain of the Golden Guard and his loyal second-in-command.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If anything happens, protect yours..."
entries.dialogueText: "If anything happens, protect yourself and {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon}. Don't worry about me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry we didn't get more time together."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Bruno tilted his head and looked at me quizzically.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, did I hear correctly? Are you truly abdicating the throne?"

entries.dialogueText: "I only wish I could have done more."

entries.dialogueText: "You've done more than enough, Titus. Now, it's time for a new chapter, for both of us.

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Farewell, my friend. May our paths..."
entries.dialogueText: "Farewell, my friend. May our paths cross again under better circumstances."

entries.dialogueText: "May the future be kinder to us all."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A flicker of disappointment briefly..."
entries.dialogueText: A flicker of disappointment briefly crossed Titus's face. However, he remained composed, bowing respectfully before taking his leave.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I trust that the future holds brig..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust that the future holds brighter days."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Hopefully sooner than later. Farew..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hopefully sooner than later. Farewell."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Spare me your pity and get out of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Spare me your pity and get out of my sight."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""But, sir, our kingdom depends on y..."
entries.dialogueText: "But, sir, our kingdom depends on your leadership."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""But, sir, Rizia's future hinges on..."
entries.dialogueText: "But, sir, Rizia's future hinges on your guidance!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At that moment, Titus ran out onto..."
entries.dialogueText: At that moment, Titus ran out onto the balcony, attempting to rush me away, but he was too late.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus stood over me, his voice a di..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus stood over me, his voice a distant murmur that I couldn't comprehend.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus nodded in confirmation."
entries.dialogueText: Titus nodded in confirmation.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your orders, sir?""
entries.dialogueText: "Your orders, sir?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a salute, Titus rushed out of..."
entries.dialogueText: With a salute, Titus rushed out of the room. In the meantime, we needed to block the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus saluted, prompting the other..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus saluted, prompting the other guards to scan the room for anything they could use to block the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was Titus and his men bringing a..."
entries.dialogueText: It was Titus and his men bringing along four other Golden Guards.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone came inside."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone came inside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was Titus and his men bringing a..."
entries.dialogueText: It was Titus and his men bringing along two other Golden Guards.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus and his men had returned. The..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus and his men had returned. They couldn't find anyone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was Titus and Sevrio bringing al..."
entries.dialogueText: It was Titus and Sevrio bringing along seven other Wruhec's Guardians.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "However, it wasn't long before an i..."
entries.dialogueText: However, it wasn't long before an influx of footsteps, more than before, could be heard.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the smoke cleared, and my hearin..."
entries.dialogueText: As the smoke cleared, and my hearing slowly returned, I saw that two nearby guards lay dead.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nearby, Titus was down, unconscious..."
entries.dialogueText: Nearby, Titus was down, unconscious but still breathing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When the smoke cleared, I saw I had..."
entries.dialogueText: When the smoke cleared, I saw I had taken down two of them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I'd been shot."
entries.dialogueText: I'd been shot.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before I could react, a mob of mask..."
entries.dialogueText: Before I could react, a mob of masked militants wielding automatic rifles stormed the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But all of my guards were dead."
entries.dialogueText: But all of my guards were dead.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I shot at our assailants until I re..."
entries.dialogueText: I shot at our assailants until I realized I wasn't firing at all. My magazine was empty.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus saluted, then readied his wea..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus saluted, then readied his weapon and assumed a defensive stance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It hit me then that I had no idea w..."
entries.dialogueText: It hit me then that I had no idea when or if I'd ever see him again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned my gaze to Lucita and her..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned my gaze to Lucita and her injury.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned my gaze to Pabel and his i..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned my gaze to Pabel and his injury.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bruno was nowhere in sight."
entries.dialogueText: Bruno was nowhere in sight.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Memories suddenly flooded my mind -..."
entries.dialogueText: Memories suddenly flooded my mind -- memories of Vina, my mother...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And Lena, my first love..."
entries.dialogueText: And Lena, my first love...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was as if all the important mome..."
entries.dialogueText: It was as if all the important moments of my life were captured in a single flash.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The life I once knew was gone."
entries.dialogueText: The life I once knew was gone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Not to mention all of my triumphs a..."
entries.dialogueText: Not to mention all of my triumphs and failures.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bruno's ears flattened, and he star..."
entries.dialogueText: Bruno's ears flattened, and he started to growl.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Sir, the militants are closing in. We have to get ready."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty! Look out!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus propelled himself between me..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus propelled himself between me and the door.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty! Get down!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus propelled himself between me..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus propelled himself between me and the door.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Whatever happens, Your Majesty, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever happens, Your Majesty, I just wanted you to know that it's been an honor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Much appreciated, but we haven't l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Much appreciated, but we haven't lost this fight yet!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Save the sentiment, Titus. We're n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Save the sentiment, Titus. We're not dead yet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, Titus, the honor is mine.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, Titus, the honor is mine."

entries.dialogueText: Titus saluted then readied his weapon, assuming a defensive stance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It dawned on me that I had no idea..."
entries.dialogueText: It dawned on me that I had no idea when or if I'd ever see him again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I felt a cold, wet nose against my..."
entries.dialogueText: I felt a cold, wet nose against my cheek. Bruno was nudging me, trying to keep me awake.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They were rapidly approaching."
entries.dialogueText: They were rapidly approaching.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bruno sniffed at the door and wagge..."
entries.dialogueText: Bruno sniffed at the door and wagged his tail eagerly. Whoever it was, they weren't hostile.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before long, the footsteps stopped..."
entries.dialogueText: Before long, the footsteps stopped right outside the barricade.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bruno's ears flattened, and he star..."
entries.dialogueText: Bruno's ears flattened, and he started to growl.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I listened closely to understand wh..."
entries.dialogueText: I listened closely to understand what was going on.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I remained still, waiting to see wh..."
entries.dialogueText: I remained still, waiting to see what would happen.

entries.dialogueText: She'd stayed by my side even as the revolutionaries closed in on Porte Drazon, watching me drink glass after glass of wine and reminisce about the days when kings still held power.

entries.dialogueText: I turned to see Sevrio, his expectant gaze awaiting my command.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Come with me. I can't go out there without backup."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "As you command, sir. May God be with you."

entries.dialogueText: "Divus zaitu, Your Majesty. May the Lord be with you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Here goes nothing."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I fought for the reforms you wante..."
entries.dialogueText: "I fought for the reforms you wanted. If there's anyone you should be angry at, it's the nobles who refused to let them pass."

entries.dialogueText: Sevrio gave a nod of confirmation.

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus

entries.dialogueText: "Right away."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus

entries.dialogueText: Sevrio immediately shot the attacker dead.

entries.dialogueText: Sevrio looked at me with solemn eyes.
